description: Stops a finished job from waiting for a person without answering it: nothing is delivered and no agent resumes. Use it when the question went stale or the finding cleared by itself (list_jobs with waiting: true finds them); the job records `closed: {at, by, reason}` and leaves the waiting list. A job still running is answered with answer_job or stopped with cancel_job instead.

reason.description: why it no longer needs a person

name: close_job
title: Close a waiting job
